speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms; to begin our evaluation, have you noticed any specific patterns to the rash, such as it appearing only on the hands or spreading to other areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your occupation with rice farming and livestock, have you noticed any specific plants, such as poison ivy or urushiol-containing plants, or any insects in the environment that might be causing these symptoms? Also, is there any history of similar reactions in your family?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a pruritic rash, numbness and tingling in the palms, thinning eyebrows, loss of eyelashes, and hypopigmented macules on the elbows is highly suggestive of leprosy (Hansen's disease). Given your history of working on a rice farm and with livestock, have you lived in close contact with anyone who also had a similar skin condition or nerve problem?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease).

Given the classic triad of hypopigmented macules, peripheral neuropathy (tingling/numbness), and specific hair loss (madarosis) in a farmer, I am requesting a slit-skin smear for acid-fast bacilli and nerve conduction studies to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Slit_skin_smear; REQUEST TEST: Nerve_conduction_study.
